scope: Plan-only cross-check of open-source DWG/DXF writer capability claims, route-specific fuzzing documentation, and downstream comparator roles.

sources: LibreDWG project README, NEWS, generated dwgwrite.1, RPM spec, HACKING, fuzz repository, and Texinfo
method.local_crosswalk: Compared source-backed route/evidence distinctions with the existing peer matrix and 7S.3/S3.7 validation cadence in DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md.
not_performed: No peer checkout, build, binary, command, or runtime execution
No native CAD application or geometry kernel run
No external drawing download or fixture addition
No production code, test, dependency, or CTest registration change

findings.evidence: NEWS for beta 0.14.1 announces initial R2004+ writing; the current README retains CRC-error caveats for R2010-R2018 and the generated dwgwrite man page says R2000 only. RPM metadata repeats an R2004 encoder milestone but does not establish entity/object fidelity.
findings.plan_effect: Require exact executable/revision/build, operation, requested and actual file versions, hashes, diagnostics, and independent validation for every peer result. Do not promote from release notes or accepted CLI options alone.

findings.evidence: LibreDWG documents distinct DWG decode, ASCII DXF, DXF/DXB, JSON, and read-write fuzz routes; its standalone setup distinguishes crashes, hangs, and leaks and supports regression replay.
findings.plan_effect: Keep generated fast per-slice tests route-specific and move bounded sanitizer/fuzz campaigns to the composed checkpoint; preserve crash reproductions as deterministic tests. No new external fuzz infrastructure is authorized by this research update.

findings.evidence: ezdxf documents ASCII/Binary DXF read/write, not DWG; FreeCAD documents DWG conversion through an external converter followed by its DXF import route.
findings.plan_effect: Keep DXF parser comparison and named FreeCAD consumer qualification distinct from native DWG parsing and semantic 3D evidence.

implementation_readiness.validation_change: No peer/full-suite/long-fuzz work per slice. Continue focused generated test plus owning CTest; schedule bounded route-specific sanitizer/fuzz campaigns at the composed checkpoint.
implementation_readiness.fixture_policy: Use in-memory or scratch-generated controls; do not commit external DWG/DXF fixtures unless already present in LibreCAD/libdxfrw or created locally from scratch.
